reason: Pre-analysis red-team identified that a productivity-versus-finance contrast on different cohorts cannot isolate a change in screening objective. Add an explicitly paired common-cohort comparison; preserve all original planned cohorts and reports.
analysis_status_at_design: No H4 empirical model scores or associations inspected by the parent; implementation first-fit status recorded separately in lock receipt.
cohort: Within each primary source and secondary target, intersect the planning MOST/MAX matched cohort with known finite nonnegative integer d3c, excluding exact2500000. Do not change H1 productivity labels when restricting. Keep d3c99 in main common cohort; its ambiguity remains documented in the existing full finance excluding99 sensitivity.
outcomes: d3c>0 reported unmet borrowing for production expansion
evaluation: Fit all16 base-protocol policies separately for each of the two outcomes on precisely the same rows in every training fold. Same routine/technology variables, preprocessing rules, equal-country sumN fit weights, source evaluation weights and four quotas. Maintain 11 country exclusions; all-primary fitting then both secondary targets. Do not select a primary outcome based on results.
reporting: Retain per-outcome full results and report paired source/country contrasts of incremental technology value over the same B baseline. Report sector/size expected-contact shares/rates for both outcomes and their differences. For the same policy, report total variation between the two normalised expected-contact allocation vectors on the common rows; this is expected-allocation distance, not realised list overlap. No row IDs or predictions in deliverables.
primary_status: Secondary pre-analysis methodological extension. The original planning B_MOST5 minus B at quota0.50 remains the sole overall primary contrast.
prohibited: No target-label use in predictors; no cross-objective causal claim, grant-benefit inference, cost-saving claim or significance claim. Generic questionnaire harmonisation limitations remain.
